activities.title: Match the job with the place.
Listen. Diego interviews firefighter Rosa. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Diego (reportero) y Rosa (bombera, voz adulta femenina).
data.script: Diego: Radio Aurora! Rosa, how long have you been a firefighter? … Rosa: For twelve years! I started when I was twenty. … Diego: What time does your work start? … Rosa: At six in the morning. We check the truck first. … Diego: What's the most difficult part? … Rosa: The smoke. That's why we carry special masks. … Diego: And the best part? … Rosa: Helping people… and sometimes cats! Last week I rescued a cat from a roof. … Diego: What should children do if they see a fire? … Rosa: Never hide! Go out fast and call one one six.
